description: Monitor assets, triage alerts, and dispatch work orders across the global fleet.

config.message: {value} assets are Offline — drag them to Maintenance on the board once a crew is assigned.

config.title: Take this asset offline?
config.text: Offline assets stop producing revenue. The Update asset status action requires High priority when the new status is Offline.

## Standard Operating Procedure

1. **Observe** telemetry trends in the selected asset.
2. _Investigate_ anomalies via linked Sensors.
3. Decide on a mitigation using the Action panel.
4. Act — submit a Work Order.

> Reference: [Field Manual §4.2](#)

`asset.id` is the primary key.
